user.title: Eberspächer EasyStart Web
user.description: Sign in with the account you use at myeberspaecher.com. This is an unofficial integration.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login for {email} no longer works. Enter the current password.

error.no_devices: The account has no EasyStart Web devices
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up

start_heating.name: Start heating
start_heating.description: Start the heater for a set time.

runtime.name: Run time
runtime.description: Minutes to run. Defaults to the Run time number.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Heating or ventilation. Defaults to the mode of the switch you call it on.

init.title: Options
init.description: What would you like to change?

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: How often to check the heater status while nothing is running. While it runs, and right after any start or stop from Home Assistant, it is checked regardless. With Off, starts made from the EasyStart app or website only show up after the next command from Home Assistant or a restart.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Start the heater by itself so the car is ready at a set time. The colder it is, the earlier it starts (set the bands under Heating bands). Without a temperature sensor the heater's own last reading is used.

data_description.temperature_entity: Optional. A sensor with the outside temperature in °C.
data_description.notify_service: Optional. For example notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Gets a message when the heater starts, fails to start, or is not needed.

heating_bands.title: Heating bands
heating_bands.description: Above the first temperature the heater is not started. Each band below has its own run time, and its own start time worked out from the ready-by time.

ventilation.title: Summer ventilation
ventilation.description: When it is this warm or warmer, run the heater's ventilation instead of heating, so the car is cooler when you get in. Needs a heater that supports ventilation.

reminder.title: Idle reminder
reminder.description: A heater that sits unused for months should be run now and then so the fuel lines and pump stay in working order. When it has not run for this many days you get a message (through the notification service set under Schedule) and a notice under Repairs, repeated weekly until it runs.

error.runtime_too_long: The longest run time is longer than the time between midnight and the ready-by time
error.bands_order: The temperatures must go from warm to cold: No heating above, then Cold, then Very cold
error.vent_below_heating: Ventilation must start at a higher temperature than No heating above

cloud_unreachable.title: Eberspächer cloud unreachable
cloud_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to reach myeberspaecher.com for several checks in a row. The last error was: {error}\n\nIf it keeps failing, check your internet and DNS settings, or whether the EasyStart Web service is down. The integration keeps trying and this notice goes away when it works again.

heater_idle.title: Car heater has not run for a while
heater_idle.description: The heater has not run for {days} days. Run it for about 10 minutes so the fuel lines and pump stay in working order. This notice goes away once it has run.
